en: Colorized landscape view over a rural valley town with red‑tiled roofs, open fields, and surrounding hills. A prominent church with a tall bell tower and onion-shaped spire stands near the center-right. The scene shows scattered houses and farm buildings across gently sloping terrain. At the top left, in red script text, it reads: "Fondo e Malosco. Val di Non."
